str:Concept.com:Description: Standard error of OBS_VALUE; required on PRODUCER-source rows where CL_STATISTIC.admits_se = Y.

str:Concept.com:Name: Lower confidence bound
str:Concept.com:Description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval; required where STD_ERR is.

str:Concept.com:Name: Upper confidence bound

str:Concept.com:Name: Number of observations
str:Concept.com:Description: Unweighted number of records; required on PRODUCER-source rows; on a share row, the denominator's records (D19).

str:Concept.com:Name: Population represented
str:Concept.com:Description: Weighted population the estimate represents; required on PRODUCER-source rows; on a share row, the denominator's population (D19).

str:Concept.com:Name: Number of numerator observations
str:Concept.com:Description: Unweighted number of records in the numerator of a share; required where STD_ERR is (D33).

str:Concept.com:Name: Design effect
str:Concept.com:Description: Design effect of the estimate: its sampling variance relative to simple random sampling (D33).

str:Concept.com:Name: Degrees of freedom
str:Concept.com:Description: Degrees of freedom of the variance estimate (D33).
